[2] subscription-state-machine.ts
    Location: /home/jake/Desktop/shad/subscription-state-machine.ts
    Lines: 459
    Purpose: 5-state FSM for subscription lifecycle management
    
    States Implemented:
    - Unsubscribed: No subscription exists
    - Pending: Payment awaiting confirmation
    - Active: Verified subscription
    - Expiring: Grace period (≤7 days before expiry)
    - Expired: Subscription ended
    
    Key Features:
    - Transition guards prevent invalid state changes
    - Grace period timer (7 days before expiry)
    - Event emission for state changes
    - Automatic expiration detection
    - Serialization for persistence
    
    Transition Matrix:
    Unsubscribed → Pending (PaymentSubmitted)
    Pending → Active (VerificationSucceeded)
    Pending → Unsubscribed (VerificationFailed)
    Active → Expiring (GracePeriodStarted)
    Active → Expired (SubscriptionExpired)
    Expiring → Pending (PaymentSubmitted/renewal)
    Expiring → Expired (SubscriptionExpired)
    Expired → Pending (PaymentSubmitted)
    
    Dependencies:
    - types_contracts/subscription.ts
    
    SPEC References:
    - §5.5: State definitions
    - SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_MACHINE_SPEC.md

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[3] subscription-cache.ts
    Location: /home/jake/Desktop/shad/subscription-cache.ts
    Lines: 420
    Purpose: Redis-backed caching with in-memory fallback
    
    Architecture:
    - Primary: Redis (shared across instances)
    - Fallback: In-memory LRU cache (process-local)
    - TTL: 72 hours for subscription state
    - Eviction: LRU policy for memory cache
    
    Cache Backends:
    1. RedisBackend - Production persistence
       - Connection pooling
       - Error recovery
       - PX (millisecond) TTL
    
    2. MemoryBackend - Offline fallback
       - LRU access tracking
       - Automatic expiration
       - Configurable max entries (default: 1000)
    
    Public Methods:
    - async initialize(): Promise<void>
    - async get(userAddress: string): Promise<CachedSubscription | null>
    - async set(userAddress: string, utxos: SubscriptionUtxo[], verification?: SpvVerificationResult): Promise<void>
    - async invalidate(userAddress: string): Promise<void>
    - async clear(): Promise<void>
    - getStats(): CacheStats
    - isCacheValid(cached: CachedSubscription): boolean
    
    Cache Structure:
    {
      utxos: SubscriptionUtxo[],
      verification?: SpvVerificationResult,
      timestamp: number,
      expiresAt: number
    }
    
    Dependencies:
    - ioredis (npm package)
    - types_contracts/subscription.ts
    
    SPEC References:
    - §5.6: Cache persistence requirements
    - §3.4: 72-hour grace period

[8] src-tauri/src/subscription.rs
    Location: /home/jake/Desktop/shad/src-tauri/src/subscription.rs
    Lines: ~750
    Purpose: Main subscription manager with overlay/cache/SPV integration
    
    Key Components:
    - SubscriptionManager struct
    - SubscriptionState enum (5 states)
    - SubscriptionStatus struct
    - CachedProof struct
    
    Public Methods:
    - async fn check_subscription(&mut self) -> Result<SubscriptionStatus>
    - async fn verify_beef_proof(&self, txid: &str, beef_hex: &str) -> Result<SpvVerificationResult>
    - async fn cache_proof(&mut self, utxo: &SubscriptionUtxo, verification: Option<SpvVerificationResult>) -> Result<()>
    - async fn load_cached_proof(&mut self) -> Result<Option<CachedProof>>
    - async fn invalidate_cache(&mut self) -> Result<()>
    - fn derive_subscription_key(identity_key: &[u8; 32], key_id: &str) -> Result<[u8; 32]>
    
    Flow:
    1. Query overlay services for subscription UTXO
    2. If found → verify BEEF proof → cache → return Active
    3. If not found/error → check cache → return Cached/Expired/GraceExceeded
    4. If no cache → return NotFound
    
    Dependencies:
    - overlay.rs (HTTP client)
    - spv.rs (SPV verification)
    - serde_json (cache serialization)
    - tokio (async I/O)
    - hmac, sha2 (BRC-42 derivation)
    
    Unit Tests: 8 tests included in module

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[9] src-tauri/src/subscription_manager.rs
    Location: /home/jake/Desktop/shad/src-tauri/src/subscription_manager.rs
    Lines: ~600
    Purpose: State machine implementation with transition validation
    
    Components:
    - SubscriptionStateMachine struct
    - StateTransition guards
    - Event emission system
    - Grace period calculation
    
    State Transition Rules:
    NotFound → Active (payment creates UTXO)
    Active → Cached (network offline, within grace)
    Cached → Active (network restored)
    Cached → Expired (subscription expires, within grace)
    Expired → GraceExceeded (> 72h offline)
    GraceExceeded → Active (network restored + valid subscription)
    
    Methods:
    - fn transition(&mut self, event: StateEvent) -> Result<()>
    - fn is_valid_transition(&self, event: StateEvent) -> bool
    - fn calculate_grace_remaining(&self) -> Option<u64>
    - fn emit_event(&self, event: StateEvent)
    - fn serialize(&self) -> Result<String>
    - fn deserialize(data: &str) -> Result<Self>
    
    Dependencies:
    - serde (serialization)
    
    Unit Tests: Multiple tests in subscription_tests.rs

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[10] src-tauri/src/spv.rs
    Location: /home/jake/Desktop/shad/src-tauri/src/spv.rs
    Lines: ~750
    Purpose: SPV verification with BEEF/BUMP parsing
    
    Key Functions:
    - fn parse_beef(beef_data: &[u8]) -> Result<BeefData>
    - fn parse_bump_array(bump_data: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<BumpEntry>>
    - fn extract_transaction_data(tx_data: &[u8]) -> Result<Transaction>
    - fn calculate_merkle_root(txid: &[u8], path: &[MerkleNode], index: u64) -> Result<[u8; 32]>
    - fn verify_block_header(header: &BlockHeader, header_data: &[u8]) -> Result<bool>
    - fn verify_spv(request: &SpvVerificationRequest, block_header: &[u8]) -> Result<SpvVerificationResult>
    
    Structs:
    - BeefData (BRC-62 structure)
    - BumpEntry (BRC-74 structure)
    - Transaction
    - BlockHeader
    - MerkleNode
    - SpvVerificationResult
    
    BRC Compliance:
    - BRC-62: BEEF parsing with version extraction
    - BRC-67: SPV verification flow
    - BRC-74: BUMP format parsing
    
    Dependencies:
    - sha2 (SHA-256 for merkle hashing)
    - hex (hex encoding/decoding)
    
    Unit Tests: 40+ tests in spv_tests.rs

[11] src-tauri/src/overlay.rs
    Location: /home/jake/Desktop/shad/src-tauri/src/overlay.rs
    Lines: ~700
    Purpose: HTTP client for BSV Overlay Services and Arcade
    
    Key Components:
    - OverlayClient struct
    - OverlayConfig struct
    - LookupResult struct
    - BroadcastResult struct
    - SubscriptionUtxo struct
    
    Methods:
    - async fn lookup_subscription(&mut self, user_address: &str) -> Result<LookupResult>
    - async fn broadcast(&mut self, raw_tx: &str) -> Result<BroadcastResult>
    - async fn health_check(&self) -> Result<HealthCheckResult>
    
    Features:
    - Retry logic with exponential backoff (2^n growth, ±30% jitter)
    - Circuit breaker (5 failure threshold, 60s cooldown)
    - Configurable timeouts (default: 10s)
    - Topic Manager queries (POST /lookup)
    - Arcade broadcasting (POST /v1/tx)
    
    Configuration:
    - overlay_url: Default from OVERLAY_URL env
    - arcade_url: Default from ARCADE_URL env
    - subscription_topic_id: Default "EDWIN_SUBS_v1"
    - timeout_ms: Default 10000
    - max_retries: Default 3
    
    Dependencies:
    - reqwest (HTTP client)
    - serde/serde_json (serialization)
    - tokio (async runtime)
    - thiserror (error handling)
    - rand (jitter calculation)
    
    Unit Tests: 9 tests in overlay module
